thread:
maya: getting a bunch of cert freshness alerts from eu-west proxies. saw handshake errors and rotator failures — think it started after yesterday's keystore RBAC change. anyone else?

sam: saw the spike too (~12:05 UTC). proxy SLOs showed handshake errors. rotator logs contain KMS denies. quick grep: 
```
error="KMSDecryptDenied" principal="service/rotator@redwood" keyId="alias/proxy-cert-eu" region="eu-west-1" requestId="abcd-1234"
```

devon: that was my change to tighten decrypt perms on keystore roles. i removed a broad decrypt grant and scoped it down, maybe missed the rotator principal. i'll check the PR.

maya: also seeing the audit log lines in eu and apac where decrypt failed and rotation skipped. sample: 
```
AUDIT event=KMS.DecryptDenied time=2025-06-10T12:06:02Z principal=service/rotator@redwood resource=alias/proxy-cert-apac region=ap-south-1 reason="not principal allowed"
```

priya: ops-oncall, can you confirm whether we reverted anything? this is a compliance exposure if certs didn't rotate.

ops-oncall: rolled the RBAC policy back to previous state at 12:20 UTC to restore rotations. handshakes recovered ~12:25. created a short incident page.

sam: thumbs up on rollback. two followups: (1) add rotator principal explicitly to the scoped role, (2) add an audit alert for KMS DecryptDenied where principal==rotator across regions, (3) add a canary decrypt as part of keystore deploys.

devon: i'll open the role-backing PR now to add the binding and include the least-privilege caveats. i'll also add a CI canary that runs a decrypt against a test key in eu/apac. PR -> https://stash.redwood/keystore/PR/1427 (WIP).

maya: we also need to backfill any certs that missed rotation in apac. two proxies reported serving certs with TTL left < 24h when rotation skipped. priya can you own the backfill list and customer comms if needed?

priya: will run the cert-age scan after lunch, escalate anything <12h TTL. also documenting this as a medium-severity vuln window since expired certs could've been presented.

sam: alert rule proposal snippet: 
```
name: kms-rotator-decrypt-deny
when: event.type == "KMS.DecryptDenied" and event.principal == "service/rotator@redwood"
for: any_region > 0
actions: pager + post-to-eng-security
```

security-bot: auditbot: Detected 3 KMS.DecryptDenied events for principal=service/rotator@redwood across eu-west-1 and ap-south-1 between 2025-06-10T12:05:00Z and 2025-06-10T12:15:00Z.

devon: timeline/owners: I'll merge the role fix (devon), Sam will add the alert (sam), Priya will run backfill and incident note (priya). plan to deploy fix + canary tonight in a staged rollout (eu -> apac -> us).

maya: small ops checklist for rollout: 1) smoke canary decrypt, 2) verify rotator logs show successful decrypt, 3) verify rotation events in audit logs, 4) monitor handshake SLOs for 30m.

ops-oncall: noted, i'll coordinate the staged rollout windows. posting runbook link in incident page.

priya: saving evidence for compliance: export audit lines + policy diff. will attach to incident.

sam: one more hardening idea — add an automated pre-merge check that warns if a keystore RBAC change would remove principals that currently have non-zero decrypt success counts in the last 7 days. reduces blast radius.

devon: agree, adding that to keystore PR template. thanks all, will update thread when PRs are merged.

maya: thanks — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
